selection_rule: v2. Candidates: every (series, T, template, horizon) the series kind allows; T = the Mondays 2026-07-06..2026-08-24; horizons 7/14/28 (count: 7). Keep a candidate when the true resolver over the weekly past windows ending before T, on rows dated history_start..T-1 only, has >= 52 windows and a YES frequency in [0.2, 0.8], and its window lies within the fetched data. Splits are series-disjoint: with random.Random(22), shuffle each source's groups (a city's two weather series, else one series), interleave the sources round-robin, give each group to the split furthest below its share of the series (40:120:40). Then, same generator, splits in order calibration (40), sealed (120), reserve (40): shuffle the split's pool, group by (source, template), shuffle the groups, take round-robin; at most 4 questions per series, whose windows [T, T+h) do not overlap. Recall positive control: the same filter at the Mondays 2025-07-07..2025-08-25, 20 questions, one per series, random.Random('22:recall').
